  18:01:22.670  > --!nocheck
-- GamerDad_Sweatshirt_Review: reproducible Studio assembly of the review model (static HoldCan pose, Headset + EnergyCan props).
-- GENERATED by scripts/gen_assembly.py from data/rig_manifest.json + data/construction_spec.json.
-- Run in the Studio command bar of a CLEAN place (Rojo disconnected) after importing the two FBX files with the 3D Importer
-- (Scale Unit Stud, factor 1, "Upload to Roblox" unchecked):
--   export/GamerDad_R15.fbx    -> model "GamerDad_R15"
--   export/GamerDad_Props.fbx  -> model "GamerDad_Props"
-- Result: Workspace.GamerDad_R15 with Headset (HeadsetMount -> Head), EnergyCan (CanGrip -> RightHand), HoldCanPose + NeutralPose folders, PoseController ModuleScript.
-- Logical (X,D,H) -> Roblox model position (-X, H, D); after the placement below the model sits exactly on that mapping (soles on Y = 0, body axis X = 0).
local ws = workspace
local m = ws:FindFirstChild("GamerDad_R15")
local wrap = ws:FindFirstChild("GamerDad_Props")
assert(m and wrap, "import both FBX files first")
assert(not m:FindFirstChild("HoldCanPose"), "already assembled")

local function R(x, d, h)
	return Vector3.new(-x, h, d)
end

-- 1. placement: the importer puts the body anywhere; shift it so that UpperTorso sits on the exact mapped bbox centre of the Blender mesh
local delta = m.UpperTorso.Position - R(0.000000, -0.145000, 3.455000)
m:TranslateBy(-delta)
print("GD placement delta", delta, "check Head", (m.Head.Position - R(0.000000, -0.183894, 5.350000)).Magnitude)

-- 2. props: one MeshPart each, ONE WeldConstraint each (Headset -> Head, EnergyCan -> RightHand)
local function mount(name, centre, part0, weldName)
	local p = nil
	for _, d in ipairs(wrap:GetDescendants()) do
		if d:IsA("MeshPart") and string.find(d.Name, name, 1, true) == 1 then
			p = d
		end
	end
	assert(p, "prop mesh missing: " .. name)
	p.Name = name
	p.Parent = ws
	p.CFrame = CFrame.new(centre)
	p.Parent = m
	p.Anchored = false
	p.CanCollide = false
	p.CanQuery = false
	p.CanTouch = false
	p.Massless = true
	local w = Instance.new("WeldConstraint")
	w.Name = weldName
	w.Part0, w.Part1 = part0, p
	w.Parent = p
	return p
end
mount("Headset", R(0.000000, -0.331300, 5.567500), m.Head, "HeadsetMount")
mount("EnergyCan", R(-1.620000, -1.320000, 3.860000), m.RightHand, "CanGrip")
wrap:Destroy()
for _, p in ipairs(m:GetDescendants()) do
	if p:IsA("BasePart") then
		p.Anchored = false
	end
	if p:IsA("MeshPart") then
		p.Color = Color3.new(1, 1, 1) -- the atlas already carries the colours: a white tint avoids a double multiplication
	end
end

-- 3. HoldCanPose = every part CFrame relative to HumanoidRootPart
local hrp = m.HumanoidRootPart
local function store(name, cfOf)
	local folder = Instance.new("Folder")
	folder.Name = name
	for _, p in ipairs(m:GetChildren()) do
		if p:IsA("BasePart") then
			local v = Instance.new("CFrameValue")
			v.Name = p.Name .. "_PartCFrame"
			v.Value = hrp.CFrame:ToObjectSpace(cfOf(p))
			v.Parent = folder
		end
	end
	folder.Parent = m
end
store("HoldCanPose", function(p)
	return p.CFrame
end)

-- 4. NeutralPose (QA control pose): both arms rigidly swung straight down about the joints (bone lengths unchanged), hand / can follow the forearm
local function rotTo(a, b)
	a, b = a.Unit, b.Unit
	local axis = a:Cross(b)
	local dot = math.clamp(a:Dot(b), -1, 1)
	if axis.Magnitude < 1e-7 then
		if dot > 0 then
			return CFrame.new()
		end
		local perp = math.abs(a.X) < 0.9 and Vector3.xAxis or Vector3.yAxis
		return CFrame.fromAxisAngle(a:Cross(perp).Unit, math.pi)
	end
	return CFrame.fromAxisAngle(axis.Unit, math.acos(dot))
end
local DOWN = Vector3.new(0, -1, 0)
local J = {
	RightShoulder = Vector3.new(1.6800000, 4.3500000, 0.0000000), RightElbow = Vector3.new(2.0200000, 3.4906980, -0.2600000), RightWrist = Vector3.new(2.0600000, 3.6906980, -0.9505071),
	LeftShoulder = Vector3.new(-1.6800000, 4.3500000, 0.0000000), LeftElbow = Vector3.new(-1.8400000, 3.4034272, 0.0000000), LeftWrist = Vector3.new(-1.9400000, 2.6915284, -0.0400000),
}
local T = {}
for _, side in ipairs({ "Right", "Left" }) do
	local S, E, W = J[side .. "Shoulder"], J[side .. "Elbow"], J[side .. "Wrist"]
	local Ru = rotTo(E - S, DOWN)
	local Tu = CFrame.new(S) * Ru * CFrame.new(-S)
	local E2 = Tu * E
	local Rl = rotTo((Tu * W) - E2, DOWN)
	local Tl = CFrame.new(E2) * Rl * CFrame.new(-E2) * Tu
	T[side .. "UpperArm"] = Tu
	T[side .. "LowerArm"] = Tl
	T[side .. "Hand"] = Tl
end
T.EnergyCan = T.RightLowerArm
T.EnergyCan = T.RightHand
store("NeutralPose", function(p)
	local t = T[p.Name]
	return t and (t * p.CFrame) or p.CFrame
end)

-- 5. PoseController inside the model
local mod = Instance.new("ModuleScript")
mod.Name = "PoseController"
mod.Source = [[--!strict
-- GamerDad PoseController (ModuleScript, also stored inside the model).
--   Apply(model, "HoldCan" | "Neutral")   HoldCan = stored display pose (default), Neutral = QA control pose (arms straight down, can follows the right hand).
--   QAFreeze(model, true [, pose])        explicit, intentional freeze for inspection: anchors every part, keeps the constraints off and (optionally) shows a pose.
--   QAFreeze(model, false)                restores the exact previous Anchored / Enabled states.
-- Both pose folders store every part CFrame relative to HumanoidRootPart.
-- Apply sets the part CFrames AND the AnimationConstraint.Transform of every joint (so the pose also holds while the model is simulated and the constraints
-- are enabled again), then ALWAYS restores the input Anchored states of every BasePart and the Enabled states of every constraint it touched, also when an
-- error occurs. It never leaves a part anchored by itself (the old Gamer Dad controller left the model anchored after Neutral).
local M = {}

local frozen: { [Model]: { anchored: { [BasePart]: boolean }, enabled: { [Instance]: boolean } } } = {}

local function isConstraint(d: Instance): boolean
	return d:IsA("AnimationConstraint") or d:IsA("BallSocketConstraint") or d:IsA("NoCollisionConstraint") or d:IsA("WeldConstraint")
end

local function snapshot(model: Model)
	local anchored: { [BasePart]: boolean } = {}
	local enabled: { [Instance]: boolean } = {}
	for _, d in ipairs(model:GetDescendants()) do
		if d:IsA("BasePart") then
			anchored[d] = d.Anchored
		elseif isConstraint(d) then
			enabled[d] = (d :: any).Enabled
		end
	end
	return anchored, enabled
end

local function restore(anchored: { [BasePart]: boolean }, enabled: { [Instance]: boolean })
	for c, v in pairs(enabled) do
		(c :: any).Enabled = v
	end
	for p, v in pairs(anchored) do
		p.Anchored = v
	end
end

function M.Apply(model: Model, which: string?)
	local folder = model:FindFirstChild((which == "Neutral") and "NeutralPose" or "HoldCanPose")
	assert(folder, "pose folder missing")
	local root = model:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart") :: BasePart
	assert(root, "HumanoidRootPart missing")
	local anchored, enabled = snapshot(model)
	local ok, err = pcall(function()
		for p in pairs(anchored) do
			p.Anchored = true
		end
		for c in pairs(enabled) do
			(c :: any).Enabled = false
		end
		local target: { [BasePart]: CFrame } = {}
		for _, v in ipairs(folder:GetChildren()) do
			local partName = string.gsub(v.Name, "_PartCFrame$", "")
			local part = model:FindFirstChild(partName)
			if part and part:IsA("BasePart") and v:IsA("CFrameValue") then
				target[part] = root.CFrame * v.Value
				part.CFrame = target[part]
			end
		end
		-- joint transforms: Part1 attachment frame = Part0 attachment frame * Transform
		for c in pairs(enabled) do
			if c:IsA("AnimationConstraint") then
				local ac = c :: AnimationConstraint
				local p0, p1, a0, a1 = ac.Part0, ac.Part1, ac.Attachment0, ac.Attachment1
				if p0 and p1 and a0 and a1 and target[p0] and target[p1] then
					ac.Transform = a0.CFrame:Inverse() * target[p0]:Inverse() * target[p1] * a1.CFrame
				end
			end
		end
	end)
	restore(anchored, enabled)
	if not ok then
		error(err, 2)
	end
end

function M.QAFreeze(model: Model, on: boolean, which: string?)
	if on then
		if not frozen[model] then
			local anchored, enabled = snapshot(model)
			frozen[model] = { anchored = anchored, enabled = enabled }
			for p in pairs(anchored) do
				p.Anchored = true
			end
			for c in pairs(enabled) do
				(c :: any).Enabled = false
			end
		end
		if which then
			local folder = model:FindFirstChild((which == "Neutral") and "NeutralPose" or "HoldCanPose")
			local root = model:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart") :: BasePart
			assert(folder and root, "pose folder / root missing")
			for _, v in ipairs(folder:GetChildren()) do
				local part = model:FindFirstChild((string.gsub(v.Name, "_PartCFrame$", "")))
				if part and part:IsA("BasePart") and v:IsA("CFrameValue") then
					part.CFrame = root.CFrame * v.Value
				end
			end
		end
	else
		local s = frozen[model]
		if s then
			restore(s.anchored, s.enabled)
			frozen[model] = nil
		end
	end
end

return M
]]
mod.Parent = m
print("GamerDad_Sweatshirt_Review assembled")

-- Dumps the assembled GamerDad_R15 (or a QA copy) as JSON lines "GDSNAP|<stage>|{...}" into the Output (command bar, Edit mode).
-- usage: set STAGE / TARGET below, run in the command bar, copy the Output (ctrl+a, ctrl+c) and parse with parse_studio_output.py
local STAGE = "assembled_HoldCan"
local TARGET = "GamerDad_R15"
local HS = game:GetService("HttpService")
local m = workspace:FindFirstChild(TARGET)
assert(m, "model not found: " .. TARGET)
local function v3(v)
	return { v.X, v.Y, v.Z }
end
local function cf(c)
	return { c:GetComponents() }
end
local hrp = m:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
local function emit(kind, t)
	print("GDSNAP|" .. STAGE .. "|" .. kind .. "|" .. HS:JSONEncode(t))
end
local hum = m:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
emit("model", { name = m.Name, children = #m:GetChildren(), hipHeight = hum and hum.HipHeight, rigType = hum and tostring(hum.RigType), hrp = hrp and { size = v3(hrp.Size), cf = cf(hrp.CFrame) } })
for _, p in ipairs(m:GetDescendants()) do
	if p:IsA("BasePart") then
		local t = { name = p.Name, class = p.ClassName, parent = p.Parent.Name, size = v3(p.Size), cf = cf(p.CFrame), anchored = p.Anchored, cancollide = p.CanCollide, canquery = p.CanQuery, cantouch = p.CanTouch,
			massless = p.Massless, color = { p.Color.R, p.Color.G, p.Color.B }, transparency = p.Transparency }
		if p:IsA("MeshPart") then
			t.meshId = p.MeshId
			t.textureId = p.TextureID
			t.meshSize = v3(p.MeshSize)
			t.doubleSided = p.DoubleSided
			local sa = p:FindFirstChildOfClass("SurfaceAppearance")
			t.surfaceAppearance = sa and { colorMap = sa.ColorMap } or nil
		end
		emit("part", t)
	elseif p:IsA("Attachment") then
		local t = { name = p.Name, parent = p.Parent.Name, position = v3(p.Position), world = v3(p.WorldPosition) }
		local op = p:FindFirstChild("OriginalPosition")
		if op and op:IsA("Vector3Value") then
			t.originalPosition = v3(op.Value)
		end
		emit("attachment", t)
	elseif p:IsA("JointInstance") or p:IsA("AnimationConstraint") or p:IsA("BallSocketConstraint") or p:IsA("WeldConstraint") or p:IsA("NoCollisionConstraint") then
		local t = { name = p.Name, class = p.ClassName, parent = p.Parent.Name }
		pcall(function()
			t.enabled = p.Enabled
		end)
		pcall(function()
			t.part0 = p.Part0 and p.Part0.Name
			t.part1 = p.Part1 and p.Part1.Name
		end)
		pcall(function()
			t.att0 = p.Attachment0 and p.Attachment0.Name
			t.att1 = p.Attachment1 and p.Attachment1.Name
			t.gap = (p.Attachment0.WorldPosition - p.Attachment1.WorldPosition).Magnitude
		end)
		emit("joint", t)
	elseif p:IsA("Folder") or p:IsA("ModuleScript") or p:IsA("Humanoid") then
		emit("other", { name = p.Name, class = p.ClassName, parent = p.Parent.Name, children = #p:GetChildren() })
	end
end
print("GDSNAP_DONE|" .. STAGE)
